data.title: ship the public v1 benchmark, gallery, and model sweep

data.body: human: first reporting milestone is sealed v1.0.0-sample.1 after commits 1-7 and all gates: four five-trial runs over the same frozen probe forms, one per protocol, preferably cheapest qualifying multimodal endpoint with enclosure.plain-v1; exactly 20 paid calls, full suite/protocol registry, stop and report before broad sweep. plan updated without weakening spend/privacy safeguards.

implementation commits 1-7 complete on feat/public-v1-release. gates: ruff clean; host full pytest 7425 passed, 16 optional-runtime skips; cairo suite rerun verified all 11600 cells; visual small-suite collision regression passed in the pinned container. paid calls: 0. exact sample policy is four protocols x five frozen probe forms with max_transport_attempts=1, so retries cannot exceed 20 provider attempts. ready for independent review before endpoint planning or spend.

provenance.reason: implementation 1-7 complete and gated; independent review required before paid sample run
